about: The 'For Today' view: which open tasks of all lists it shows, in which order, and under which heading. Implementations:
forToday in worker/public/js/model.js and Get-ForToday in desktop/rules.ps1. 'now' is the local wall-clock time.
Each group has 'projects' (the lists, in their order) and 'tasks' in file order: [id, project, status mark, due date or
'' for none, due time or '', text]. 'expected' is [[id, bucket], ...] in display order. A bucket is 'over' (the deadline
has passed: an earlier date, or today's time gone), 'today' or 'soon' (tomorrow to 3 days ahead). Only to do ' ', in
progress '/' and blocked '!' tasks with text count; a task without a deadline, or in a list that is not in 'projects',
is left out. Order: by date, then a task with a time before one without, by time; ties by list, then file order.
